activities.name: CALCULUS
activities.notes: Split into part 1 and part 2, examined separately on the same day. Past tests published for each. Also the activity that clears an OFA if one is outstanding.

activities.name: COMPUTER PROGRAMMING, ALGORITHMS AND DATA STRUCTURES
activities.notes: Programming plus algorithms; solutions published as code. Examined at Milano Statale. Two modules.

activities.name: KNOWLEDGE REPRESENTATION AND REASONING
activities.notes: Two modules (Penaloza, Palmonari), examined on the same day. Both publish past papers with solutions.

activities.name: MACHINE LEARNING, ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORKS AND DEEP LEARNING
activities.notes: Two parts with a combined final mark; read the overall-exam notice before planning which appello to take.

activities.name: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR COMMUNICATION AND MARKETING
activities.notes: Bicocca-taught, so its material is on the Bicocca platform. Non-technical.

activities.name: PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL INFERENCE
activities.notes: The largest past-paper archive of any course in the plan, with worked solutions. Two modules, both required. Highly practicable but 12 CFU of material.

activities.name: THEORETICAL AND QUANTUM PHYSICS FOR AI
activities.notes: Split across two universities, so the two parts are scheduled independently. Material lives on the Statale platform, not Kiro.

activities.name: ETHICS, LAW AND AI
activities.notes: 12 CFU but essay/discursive rather than technical. Three lecturers; confirm which parts are examined together.

activities.name: BRAIN MODELLING
activities.notes: Thin Kiro presence. Casellato teaches it at Bicocca; check the Bicocca e-learning page.

activities.name: COMPUTATIONAL LOGIC
activities.notes: Assessment centres on exam assignments rather than a conventional paper. Only 18 activities on Kiro; confirm the format with Ghilardi.

activities.name: COGNITIVE PSYCHOLOGY
activities.notes: Self-test quizzes per chapter, and the exam has separate written and oral appelli in the calendar. Memorisation-led rather than derivation-led.

activities.name: DATA MINING AND KNOWLEDGE EXTRACTION
activities.notes: Three assignments plus a written exam; a mock exam and a past assignment are published.

activities.name: FUZZY SYSTEMS AND EVOLUTIONARY COMPUTING
activities.notes: Written paper plus a lab component, both with published samples and model answers.

activities.name: STATISTICAL MODELLING
activities.notes: Thin Kiro presence: material is likely distributed elsewhere by D'Angelo. Ask for past papers directly.

activities.name: TEXT MINING AND NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
activities.notes: Question samples for three separate years plus a full practice paper.

activities.name: WEB AND SOCIAL MEDIA SEARCH AND ANALYSIS
activities.notes: Bicocca-taught. Same track as Information retrieval, so the material overlaps with the IR project.

activities.name: ORGANIZATION THEORY AND DESIGN
activities.notes: Free-choice exam outside the AI degree, so its dates follow its own course, not the BAI session calendar. Check its appelli in Esse3.

coursework_in_parallel.name: FINAL EXAM
coursework_in_parallel.notes: A report on a topic explored in a stage, project work or laboratory, supervised by a course lecturer. Must be uploaded in PDF/A one week before the graduation day.

coursework_in_parallel.name: INFORMATION RETRIEVAL AND RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Assessed by project with published instructions and templates. No sit-down exam to schedule.

coursework_in_parallel.name: LABORATORY OF MACHINE LEARNING
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Nine report submissions, no exam. Deadline-driven, so it can run in parallel with exam preparation.

coursework_in_parallel.name: PROJECT WORK
coursework_in_parallel.notes: F-ALTRO activity. Not on Kiro; agree the brief with a supervisor. Can overlap with the final report.
